customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be worth the money and appreciate its performance, installation process, and taste. The water quality receives positive feedback, with one customer noting the TDS level is below 100, and they like its appearance, with one highlighting the modern touch panel with LED indicators. They value the 2-year hassle-free service. However, reliability is a concern, with multiple customers reporting that the purifier stopped working within a month of use.

reviews.author: Dr.
reviews.title: Best in its category
reviews.body: Very satisfying and user friendly product. Customer service very good. The most unique part is it's AMC (annual maintainance charge) which is unconditional maintainance for 2 years through 5000 inr. Reviewing after One month of usages and till now no problem. Online interface for performance check up is smooth. Overall nice to buy. Instalation was easy and prompt.

reviews.author: Madhan
reviews.title: Not superb for this price, water taste is good for me
reviews.body: I like the product and water also tastes good. Still few issues are there on build and software. 1. Tray build is not good which is already broken for me in a month 2. Software bugs, if you are in offline water consumption level is not tracking. 3. Same as everyone touch is not working. Might need a larger touch sensitivity area so that it can register easily These issues can be adjustable, but overall it's a good purifier as of now 😂

reviews.author: Vag
reviews.title: Water taste good and quality tds level within limits
reviews.body: Installation went very well.Urban clap person worked professionally. Overall I am satisfied.

reviews.author: Siba Prasad Mohanty
reviews.title: Excellent Product & Hassle-Free Experience – Highly Recommended!
reviews.body: Really happy with my experience with the Urban Company Native M2 Pro. The product looks premium, works smoothly, and the performance has been excellent so far. The water quality is good, and the overall experience has been hassle-free. The installation and service were also handled professionally. Great product for the price, and I’m satisfied with my purchase. Highly recommended! 👍

reviews.author: Nandan kumar
reviews.title: Service and easy way to handle
reviews.body: These product is great. Water quality is very good. Service is excellent. Installation was very quick. It's very easy to track everything because everything is visible in the app.
